entities.name: GHSR1 mouse
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Mus musculus growth hormone secretagogue receptor type 1 (UniProt Q99P50); 364 aa, 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Predicted and domain-supported seven-transmembrane class A GPCR architecture; Pfam 7tm_1 spans positions 59–321.
Functions as a ghrelin receptor; activation couples primarily to Gq and stimulates phospholipase C signaling with DAG and IP3 production.
Localized to the cell surface/plasma membrane as a multipass membrane protein.
Biological roles include appetite regulation and promotion of growth hormone secretion; neuronal receptor heteromerization can contribute to synaptic plasticity and related neuronal signaling.

entities.name: GHSR1 human
observations: Reviewed human homolog Q92847 shares 95.4% identity over 100% query coverage with the analyzed sequence.
Annotated as a ghrelin-specific G protein-coupled receptor at the plasma membrane/cell surface.

entities.name: GHSR Gq PLC signaling
observations: Ghrelin binding activates GHSR, coupling to Gq and modulating phospholipase C effectors to generate DAG and IP3.

entities.name: Growth hormone secretion
observations: GHSR activation promotes growth hormone secretion.

entities.name: Appetite regulation
observations: Ghrelin-GHSR signaling contributes to appetite regulation.
